name: Kindroid
ontology_notes: Official help names three memory types (persistent, cascaded, retrievable) across five systems. Persistent: Backstory, Key Memories, example messages, directives, group context. Retrievable: Journal entries (keyword lore, up to 8 keyphrases, max 3 individual + 3 global recalled per user message) and long-term memory. Cascaded: expanded chat context. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.

ontology.evidence: Help Center documents named fields (Backstory, Key Memories, User backstory, Journals, LTM, cascaded) as prose slots, not public types/tables. Relationship lives in Backstory prose. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: User edits Backstory/Key Memories/Journals. LTM consolidation is automatic ('spans all messages & is infinite for all users' on Ember guide). User can deprioritize LTM and turn off LTM recall. Extractor internals INCONCLUSIVE.
write_policy.label: inferred

read_policy.evidence: Persistent fields always considered. Journals recall when user message contains a keyphrase (not AI messages). Max 3+3 journals per message. Chat break resets short-term, optional cascaded wipe. LTM recall toggleable. Engine internals INCONCLUSIVE.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: User can edit Backstory and Journals. How LTM handles contradicting later facts is not specified. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
supersession.label: guess

temporal.evidence: Help describes cascaded context spanning thousands of messages on higher tiers, Scene Anchors, and chat break as a short-term reset. No public 'last Tuesday' API. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
temporal.label: inferred

identity_split.evidence: Kin Backstory vs User backstory vs Key Memories vs per-Kin journals vs global journals vs group context. Groupchats do not read other Kins' backstories. Still prose, not a relationship object. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: User chooses keyphrases and can turn off LTM recall. Ember guide says to move lore to Journals so Backstory stays lean. No documented trauma/spoiler type. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No public provenance/filter docs. Chat break is the published recovery tool. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
poisoning.label: guess

forgetting.evidence: Edit/delete journal and backstory. Deprioritize LTM entries (Ember guide). Chat break does not wipe LTM/journals unless cascaded wipe is chosen. True delete of consolidated LTM internals INCONCLUSIVE.
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: Ember guide publishes character budgets for short-term, cascaded, additional AI backstory, user backstory, and recalled LTM+journals by tier. Journals compete with LTM for that recalled budget. Exact token numbers vary by tier in the matrix. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: Closed cloud app. No self-host of the engine in official docs.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No official MCP server in help docs reviewed.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Companion-native UX with pinned backstory, keyword journals, and claimed infinite LTM. Public docs still treat memory as prompt text plus opaque retrieval. No typed relationship state. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
open_unknowns: Exact per-tier token numbers from the Ember matrix (page is JS-rendered; snippets seen via search).
Whether Key Memories are always-on or retrieved.
